title: 20 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Israeli President H.E Reuven Rivlin Visits Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi, India
story:
Israeli President H.E Reuven Rivlin Visits Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi Pujya Anandswarup Swami and senior sadhus traditionally welcomed Israeli President H.E Reuven Rivlin with a garland of flowers. Accompanying the Israeli President was the First Lady of Israel, Nechama Rivlin, who was traditionally welcomed with a garland of flowers by senior members of Swaminarayan Akshardham.

In addition, members of the Israeli delegation to India joined the visit. After marveling at the Mayur Dwar (Peacock Gate), the President and First Lady viewed the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir where they offered their respects and admired the Mandir’s art and architecture.

Touched by the universal messages of peace and harmony, they also offered their best wishes for world peace. Sharing his sentiments at Akshardham, President of the State of Israel, H.E. Reuven Rivlin, wrote, “Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: May all love thee prosper.

May all be blessed.” Sharing her experience of Akshardham, First Lady of Israel, Nechama Rivlin, wrote, “On a nice and pleasant evening, we came to visit the Akshardham Temple and we stay speechless because of the beauty of this important and divine place.”

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj sanctifies a plot of land acquired for the construction of a mandir
options.story:
Swamishri sanctified a plot of land acquired for the construction of a mandir.

Showers his immortalizing words on an audience of bhaktas. Visits the Khambhada village. Visits the new mandir construction site, Dholka. Welcomed by Haka Bapu. Devotionally absorbed in the darshan of Harikrishna Maharaj in the mandir shrine. After being garlanded during the welcome. Blesses bhaktas in jovial mood. In a jovial, illustrious and attentive mood. A touch of divine care and informality. Crowning a peacock as a symbol of appreciation after a presentation by sadhus. Listens attentively to a tale of sorrow and pain from an old blind bhakta. Consoling and reassuring. Blesses with sanctified flowers. "Always see the virtues of all".

options.headline: Visited the Shri Govindraiji mandir for darshan
options.story:
This morning Swamishri visited the famous Govind Dev Mandir, old Swaminarayan mandir and the BAPS hari mandir for darshan. Swamishri attended and blessed the evening satsang assembly in Hindi.

Visited the Shri Govindraiji mandir for darshan. On the streets of Jaipur during his mandir darshan visit. At BAPS hari mandir. On a mandir site observation tour. Blesses the assembly. Blesses an evening satsang assembly. Looks at the plan of Jaipur shikharbaddh mandir. Is welcomed with a garland after his arrival. Addresses an evening satsang assembly. Blesses the bhaktas. Bapa with bhaktas of Jaipur Satsang mandal. Inaugurates the Sant Ashram. Is honored with a garland. A senior bhakta talks to Bapa during a personal meeting. Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj on assembly stage. Addresses a satsang assembly.
